annotations.title: Send a build to a TestFlight group

description: Assign a build to a TestFlight beta group so testers can install it (defaults to newest processed build). Needs confirm:true: Apple notifies every tester immediately and the notification cannot be recalled. Pro feature.

build_id.description: Specific build ID. Omit for newest VALID build.

confirm.description: Required. Every tester in the group is notified immediately.

name: assign_build_to_group
